mapper.sql: id, type, cfg_id, corp_name, api_type, direction, method, api_path, api_url, req_body, resp_body, http_status, success, err_code, err_msg, cost_ms, error_stack, operator_id, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime

sql.if: and (api_path like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or api_url like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or corp_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or err_msg like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or err_code like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')

mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (type, cfg_id, corp_name, api_type, direction, method, api_path, api_url, req_body, resp_body, http_status, success, err_code, err_msg, cost_ms, error_stack, operator_id, modedatacreatedate, modedatacreatetime) values (#{e.type}, #{e.cfgId}, #{e.corpName}, #{e.apiType}, #{e.direction}, #{e.method}, #{e.apiPath}, #{e.apiUrl}, #{e.reqBody}, #{e.respBody}, #{e.httpStatus}, #{e.success}, #{e.errCode}, #{e.errMsg}, #{e.costMs}, #{e.errorStack}, #{e.operatorId}, #{e.modedatacreatedate}, #{e.modedatacreatetime})
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount, isnull(avg(case when cost_ms is not null then cost_ms else 0 end), 0) as avgCost from ${table} where 1 = 1

select type as typeCode, count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from ${table} where 1 = 1
and cfg_id in
#{cid}
and 1 = 0
group by type order by count(1) desc

select api_type as apiType, count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when success = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as successCount, sum(case when success = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount from ${table} where 1 = 1
and cfg_id in
#{cid}
and 1 = 0
group by api_type order by count(1) desc
